faq.question: Who are these resources for?
faq.answer: Anyone. This resource is designed for schools, nonprofits, and any individuals or organizations serving students in grades K–8. The materials work for after-school programs and home learning, and all full-length resources are provided at no cost.

faq.question: Why use our resources?
faq.answer: We are youth-led and understand student needs. Our resources are fully developed by teens and focused for kids with fun, relatable content for their age. All full-length resources are completely free.

faq.question: What do you get?
faq.answer: Each month, you will receive 1–2 resources (slides + recorded). These can be used as teaching materials for English exposure, personal finance lessons, or both.

faq.question: How do you utilize these resources?
faq.answer: The materials are flexible and adaptable. You may use them as a full lesson or a mini workshop, and customize them based on your group size and time constraints. Examples are available in our Resource Hub.
